subject: Marketplace metering, listing terms & edge-case language
messages:
From: Marketplace Listing Specialist (AWS) <aws-marketplace-team@amazon.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
Cc: Sarah Lewis <sarah.lewis@acmecorp.com>
Date: 2027-02-14T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: Quick review: metering language + listing terms for Nimbus Analytics

Hi Kimberly,

Thanks for sending the draft assets. I pulled a couple quick items from our intake review that will block publish until we align: 

1) Metering edge-cases — how do you want us to describe incidental charges for burst usage vs reserved capacity? Our catalog taxonomy expects a one-sentence callout plus a link to the pricing table.
2) Terms & disclaimers — we need a short SLA blurb if you plan to advertise a latency or availability target on the product page. If not, we recommend removing specific numbers.
3) Free trial mechanics — the current copy implies a "30-day free trial" but the SKU configuration shows a metered trial with credit limits. Please confirm wording.

Attached: product_page_draft_v4.docx (copy), metering-edgecases-matrix.xlsx (ask matrix).

Can you send a consolidated reply with the preferred phrasing and the final pricing CSV? I can then route to the catalog team for final validation.

Thanks,
Anna Mercado
Marketplace Listing Specialist — AWS Partner Network
aws-marketplace-team@amazon.com

--
Note: This message is part of the AWS Marketplace publish intake. If you need to redact technical claims, flag them in-line and we'll run the legal checks before approval.

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marketplace Listing Specialist (AWS) <aws-marketplace-team@amazon.com>, Sarah Lewis <sarah.lewis@acmecorp.com>
Date: 2027-02-14T10:03:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Quick review: metering language + listing terms for Nimbus Analytics

Team — looping you in to confirm how we want to present metering/trial language for Nimbus. Quick context: Nimbus will run primarily reserved clusters with occasional burst; they asked for a 30-day trial as promotional credit. AWS needs accurate wording for the public product page.

Can each of you:
- Ben: propose a one-line metering blurb that contrasts reserved vs burst and points to the pricing table.
- Jonas: confirm whether we should call out an SLA (we currently do not have an SLA product tier in this listing).
- Marissa: validate the trial wording against the contract (Sarah, cc'd) — is it credits or a true time-limited free SKU?

Deadline: I need a consolidated reply by 2pm PT so I can send back to Anna before EOD.

Thanks,
Kimberly
Head of Marketplace GTM, Redwood Inference
kimbly_park@redwood.ai

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-02-14T11:22:00-08:00
Subject: RE: Quick review: metering language + listing terms for Nimbus Analytics

Kim — draft one-liners below. I kept them succinct so AWS can drop them into the hero/benefits area and link to pricing.

Metering blurb (hero slot, 1 line):
"Pay for reserved capacity with optional burst billing for transient spikes; see per-hour pricing and burst limits in the pricing table."

Metering blurb (fine-print, 1 sentence):
"Reserved instances are billed at the contracted hourly rate; burst usage beyond reserved capacity is billed at the metered on-demand rate and subject to per-account burst caps."

Trial wording suggestion for product page: 
"New customers receive USD 500 in Marketplace credits valid for 30 days; credits apply to metered and reserved usage. Unused credits expire at the end of the trial period."

SLA note (Jonas to confirm): I did not include an availability or latency SLA in the hero language. If we advertise any numeric SLA we must attach a support and escalation matrix to the listing.

Attaching pricing_table.csv with the sample numbers aligned to Nimbus contract.

—Ben
Director, Marketplace Ops
ben_carter@redwood.ai

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
To: Marketplace Listing Specialist (AWS) <aws-marketplace-team@amazon.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Sarah Lewis <sarah.lewis@acmecorp.com>
Date: 2027-02-14T15:46:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Quick review: metering language + listing terms for Nimbus Analytics

Hi Anna — thanks for the fast turn. Consolidated answers below and attached the pricing CSV. Please confirm once you've accepted these and we can schedule a final validation pass.

1) Metering copy (hero + fine print) — accepted. Use the hero slot first-line from Ben; for the expanded pricing footnote use the fine-print sentence. Link the hero line to the pricing table.

2) SLA language — we will NOT advertise a numeric SLA on the public product page. Please omit any availability percent in the listing; instead include this sentence under "Support & policies": 
"Support response times are outlined in the customer agreement; production SLAs are available via enterprise contract."

3) Trial mechanics — confirmed with Sarah (cc): this is USD 500 in Marketplace credits that expire after 30 days and apply to both reserved and metered usage. Please reflect exactly that phrase on the listing.

4) Edge cases matrix — see the attached metering-edgecases-matrix.xlsx; it maps burst thresholds and account caps. If AWS catalog requires an alternative short phrasing for editorial reasons, please propose it and we'll accept minor edits.

Attachments: pricing_table.csv, metering-edgecases-matrix.xlsx

Next steps: Anna, if these work I can approve the asset and you can move to catalog validation. If legal needs to tweak the sentence on support, loop in legal and we'll expedite.

Best,
Kimberly Park
Head of Marketplace GTM, Redwood Inference
kimberly_park@redwood.ai

--
Forwarded attachments: product_page_draft_v4.docx (finalized copy), pricing_table.csv (v1 numbers), metering-edgecases-matrix.xlsx (mapping).
